title: Seeded matrix product verification program
statement: Let $n,r\in\mathbb{N}$, let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $s:\{0,1\}^r\to\mathbb{F}_2^n$ be a seed map. The program draws the Boolean seed vector used by the random-bit-vector program for parameters $n,r$, charges the specified matrix-product verification local work for dimension $n$, and returns the seeded verification result as a Boolean value; it uses membership-query access.
hypotheses_covered: Seed map from $r$ Boolean bits to $\mathbb{F}_2^n$
